notes.title: Christmas Day Release!
notes.notes:
ːsteamthisː ℍ 𝕌 𝔾 𝔼  ːsteamthisː 𝕌 ℙ 𝔻 𝔸 𝕋 𝔼 ːsteamthisː 

It's a Christmas miracle! Only two days left until Randy Blaster 3D 1.0 releases on Christmas Day!!!

Sorry for the silence, a lot has been going on in my life. I plan on giving a proper update soon, but for now, I'm currently working tirelessly to get as much polish in as possible for 1.0. I will be wrapping development on Christmas Eve, publishing on Christmas Day, and then immediately disappearing with my girlfriend for a week-long vacation. 

Any bugs will be addressed once I get back. So when you do inevitably find a way to break the game, be sure to share it in the ⁠feedback channel in our Official Discord  

ALSO, quick callout:
We ran into a licensing issue with our audio middleware (Wwise), so unfortunately this first release will be missing all the amazing sound design work DATAGIRL put in over this last month. Consider 1.0 to be a soft release to share with friends until this has been addressed in patch 1.1. Stay tuned for more updates!

A few other things that are temporarily disabled until a future patch:

 Steam Leaderboards and Achievements (works, but I'm fixing the layout)
 Story Mode (needs to be reworked)

❤️ I hope you'll love where this first release ends up ❤️
 - Jameson / nanoshrine

notes.title: Official Closed Alpha Release is Live!
notes.notes:
🚨 BIG UPDATE:  🚨

The official Alpha has been made available for everyone who signed up for the steam playtest. HUUUUGE thank you to everyone who signed up! There's still more to do but I'm beyond excited to share the progress.

The focus of this alpha release is to get feedback on core survival gameplay mechanics and balancing. The story mode, survival run builder, Twitch sandbox, and misc settings will remain disabled for now. Plenty of new shop upgrades and items will be coming in future releases. First I need to make sure the base is solid before adding the garnish 🌿 🔥

Stay update to date: @nanoshrine and Randy Blaster Twitter

Please give all these contributors some love: 
Audio Director: @IMDATAGIRL
Sprite Artist: @nexinita
Illustrator: @justwharton
Level Designer: Kayne
Composer: Dial-up for Murder
Evil Boss/Voice Actor: @3DBLAST4EVER

Lastly, an update on the dev stream. I will be taking a break from streaming to breathe for a bit and allow folks to submit their feedback on the discord.

I will be back with a new stream schedule at the start of December 🙏 thank you for your patience

-nanoshrine
